comment: Shared test vectors for the risk rules (M8; M6/M7 added reviewOnly; automatic approval added documentFirm, testSession, faceMatchCountsForApproval, uncalibratedCounted and autoApproval), run by supabase/functions/_shared/risk.test.ts (TypeScript) and supabase/tests/70_m8_test.sql (private.risk_evaluate, private.risk_config_errors): both must give exactly these results. defaultConfig is threshold version 2 as the M8 migration seeds it; autoApprovalConfig is the version the automatic-approval migration adds.

assessments.name: clean passport with every check: approve
clean passport, liveness and face match missing: review, band approve
low provisional signal under the approve cut-off
printed text differs from the code lines: between the cut-offs
two firm signals reach the reject cut-off: reject even with checks missing
lowering the reject cut-off turns one firm signal into a reject
raising the approve cut-off: band approve, still review while checks are missing
a hard flag always means review, even with a firm score over the cut-off
provisional signals alone never reject
a document always decided by a person
always reviewed even when firm signals would reject
an unknown signal goes to a person
a switched-off signal adds nothing
the score is capped at 1
sums are exact: 0.1 + 0.2 is at the 0.3 cut-off
a hard flag switched off still sends the case to a person
the reject reason follows the first firm signal
a firm signal of weight 0 gives no reason; the next firm one does
every check missing and no document
liveness and face match ran and did not pass (M6/M7)
auto decide does not change the assessment
cut-offs at the extremes
M7: a face match is review-only, so a clean case is never recommended for approval
M7: review-only never stops a reject on firm signals
M6/M7: liveness and face match flagged, the face match review-only
M7: review-only and missing checks are listed in the contract's order, unknown ones after
auto approval: every condition holds
auto approval: a cni_biometric with every condition holds
auto approval switched off by an admin (autoDecide false): recommended, not approved
auto approval: the face match not counted (admin switch-off): review
auto approval: a version stored before the setting existed does not count the face match
auto approval: never a real session
auto approval: missing facts mean no (not firm, not a test session)
auto approval: the document check is not firm
auto approval: a document without code lines (old CNI) is never approved automatically
auto approval: an expired document
auto approval: under 18
auto approval: printed text differs from the code lines, even with its weight at 0
auto approval: a firm signal switched off still blocks
auto approval: a hard flag (photo used elsewhere)
auto approval: a poor photo, even with its weight at 0
auto approval: the server's photo check is missing
auto approval: liveness did not pass
auto approval: liveness missing
auto approval: the face match did not pass (under the threshold)
auto approval: the face match missing
auto approval: provisional signals above the approve cut-off
auto approval: a low provisional signal under the cut-off is allowed
auto approval: an unknown signal
